components.note: 承接上句，引出结果；as a result 是结果连接语
置于句首引发倒装，表示「也不」，承接前句的否定
倒装后系动词 are 提前；完整逻辑是「更短工时也同样不见踪影」

clauses: 含否定或半否定成分；若置于句首，主句须部分倒装。
本句主干为「并列连接语 + 结果状语 + neither 引导的倒装省略句」，先找限定动词再切分修饰成分。

phrases.meaning: 因此、结果
phrases.usage: 作连接性状语，常置于句首并以逗号隔开；后接结果分句。
phrases.example: It rained all day; as a result, the match was cancelled. 下了一整天雨，比赛因此取消。

phrases.meaning: 更短的（short 的比较级）
phrases.usage: 注意区分：shorter（更短）/ shortest（最短）。常见搭配：shorter than / the shorter the supply。
phrases.example: The shorter the supply, the higher the price. 供应越少，价格越高。

phrases.meaning: 工作的（形容词）；work 的现在分词
phrases.usage: 注意区分：working（工作的）/ work（工作）。常见搭配：working parents / flexible working。
phrases.example: Working parents need flexible hours. 职场父母需要弹性工时。

pitfalls: neither 置于句首须部分倒装（are 提前），且承接前句的否定含义。
本句省略了表语，完整逻辑是 neither are those shorter working weeks to be seen。
shorter 是比较级，呼应凯恩斯预测的 shorter working week。
as a result 是副词短语，不能直接连接两个句子，要用分号或句号；as a result of 后才接名词。
analysis.paragraphRole: 收束全文：繁荣没落到多数人头上，工时缩短也就无从谈起，回扣标题之问。

questions.stem: Some people view socializing at the workplace as a chance to develop personal relationships.
As ordinary American workers' average hourly pay had decreased despite increasing productivity, they had to work just as many hours as before to keep their living standards.
American workers' average weekly working time has not changed for nearly half a century.
Friedman believes inequality in the U.S. largely explains why increasing productivity has not resulted in reduced working hours.
Many economists assume people's thirst for material things has prevented them from enjoying more leisure time.
An economist's prediction about a shorter average working week seemed to be correct for a time in the 20th century.
In the U.S. labor market, the primary concern of people with less schooling and fewer skills is to secure any employment even if it is low-paid.
Keynes was right in predicting that technology would make the economy much more productive.
Many of the highest earners have a keen interest in and love for what they are doing.
According to Keynes, there would be a shorter working week with everyone's standard of living continuing to rise.

access.sense: 接触机会、使用权（不可数）/ 访问、获取
examples: They were denied access to paid leave. 他们被拒绝享有带薪假。

more.confusables: access（接触/访问）/ excess（过度）

examples: According to the study, rates are stable. 根据这项研究，比率稳定。

more.confusables: according to（根据，后接来源）/ because of（因为）

actual.sense: 实际的、真实的、现存的（in actual fact 事实上）
examples: But by 2013 the average hourly wage for ordinary workers had fallen 5 percent from the 1973 level in terms of actual purchasing power. 可到 2013 年，按真实购买力算，普通工人时薪反而比 1973 年低了 5%。

more.confusables: actual / actually（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

actually.sense: 实际上、事实上；居然（表出乎意料）
examples: In reality the female actually did most of it. 现实中主要还是女性在做。

more.confusables: actually（实际上）/ currently（目前）/ in fact（事实上）

afford.sense: 负担得起（afford to do / afford sth）
examples: Few families can afford full-time care. 很少有家庭负担得起全职照护。

more.confusables: afford（负担得起）/ effort（努力）

more.roots: agri（田地，词根 agr = field）+ cult（耕作，词根，同 cultivate/culture）+ -ure（名词后缀）
more.confusables: agriculture（农业，不可数）/ agricultural（农业的，形容词）/ farming（耕作、务农，动名词）/ agribusiness（农业综合企业）

examples: According to Friedman, between 1947 and 1973 the average hourly wage for normal workers (those who were not in management roles) in private industries other than agriculture nearly doubled in terms of what their money could buy. 弗里德曼算过：1947 至 1973 年，剔除管理层、不算农业，普通私企员工的时薪按实际购买力几乎翻倍。
Inequality declined in America during the period following World War II, along with the duration of the working week. 二战后那几十年，贫富差距和工时是一道往下走的。

more.confusables: along / alongside（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

examples: Although these accounts touch on real concerns, they miss the whole. 尽管这些报道触及真实担忧，却忽略了全貌。

more.confusables: although + 从句 / despite + 名词

always.sense: 总是、一直、永远；始终（本文指「总是成为他人的囚徒」）
examples: Perhaps people just never feel materially satisfied, always wanting more money to buy the next new thing. 头一种解释是：人永远不知足，总惦记着赚钱买下一个新玩意儿。
The American Civil Liberties Union filed the case. 美国公民自由联盟提起了诉讼。

more.confusables: America（美国/美洲）/ American（美国的/美国人）

amount.sense: 数量（不可数）；总额 / 合计为
examples: They share the same amount of care. 他们承担同等数量的照护。

more.roots: a-（=ad- 朝向）+ mount（山，词根，同 mountain）→ 累积成堆 → 总量
more.confusables: amount of（接不可数）/ number of（接可数）

appeals.sense: 呼吁、恳求；有吸引力、诉诸（第三人称单数）；上诉（复数）
examples: This is a theory that appeals to many economists. 这个说法，不少经济学家都买账。

more.confusables: appeals / appealing（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

argues.sense: 主张、论证、争辩；争论、争吵（第三人称单数）
examples: But Friedman argues that the evidence for this theory is far from conclusive. 可弗里德曼说，这点证据根本不足以定论。

more.confusables: argues / arguments / argument（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

argument.sense: 论点、论据、理由；争论、争吵；论证

more.confusables: argument（争论，可数；论点、论据）/ argument with sb about sth / have an argument（争吵）/ argument 与 quarrel（quarrel 偏情绪化吵嘴）

examples: "This argument is, at best, far from sufficient," he writes. 可弗里德曼直接否了：这理由顶多算沾边，远远解释不通。

assume.sense: 假定、认为、想当然；承担（责任）、呈现（形态）

more.roots: as-（=ad- 朝向）+ sum（拿取，词根 sum/sumpt，同 consume/presume/resume）+ -e
more.confusables: assume（假定；承担；呈现）/ assume that（认为）/ assuming (that)（假如，连词）/ assume 与 presume（presume 偏「基于证据姑且认定」）/ assumption（名词）

examples: Rather, we can assume it is because they need the money. 说到底，还是因为得挣钱糊口。

average.sense: 平均数、平均水平；平均的、普通的（above/below average）；平均为
examples: In 1930 the average working week was 47 hours in the United States. 1930 年，美国人平均每周要干 47 小时。

barely.sense: 几乎不、勉强、仅仅（本文指几乎不必工作）

more.confusables: barely（几乎不，本身含否定，不再加 not）/ hardly / scarcely（同义，都含否定）/ barely…when/before（一…就…，置句首主句倒装）/ barely 与 nearly（几乎，肯定义，反用会错）

examples: Over the next century, he predicted, the economy would become so productive that people would barely need to work at all. 他预言，往后一百年生产力会高到几乎用不着人干活。
It has become a public health problem. 它已成为公共卫生问题。

more.confusables: become（变得/成为）/ get（变得，口语）/ turn（变成，强调转变结果）

believes.sense: 相信、认为（believe 的复数/三单形式）
examples: Friedman believes that for many top earners, work is a labor of love. 弗里德曼的看法是：不少高薪族干活，是因为真喜欢。

more.confusables: believes（复数/三单）/ believe（原形）

below.sense: 在…下面、低于；在下面、如下
examples: It has stayed at just below 40 hours for nearly five decades. 近五十年来，它一直卡在 40 小时差一点的位置。

more.confusables: below / belonging（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

best.sense: 最好的（good/well 的最高级）；最、最好地；最好的人或物
examples: "This argument is, at best, far from sufficient," he writes. 可弗里德曼直接否了：这理由顶多算沾边，远远解释不通。

bit.sense: 一点儿、一小块、少量（a bit 稍微；a bit of）
examples: This is a bit below his four-to eight-fold predicted range. 比他预告的四到八倍，还差一截。

brilliantly.sense: 出色地、极好地；灿烂地、明亮地
examples: After all, the economy as a whole has grown even more brilliantly than he expected. 说到底，整个经济的表现比他预想的还亮眼。
Few horses captured the British public's affection. 很少有马赢得英国公众的喜爱。

more.confusables: British（英国的）/ English（英格兰的/英语的）/ the UK（英国，国家）

burden.sense: 负担、重担、累赘；使负重、使烦恼
examples: They are doing work they care about and are interested in, and doing more of it is not necessarily a burden. 干的本就是自己上心、感兴趣的事，多干点也算不上负担。

busy.sense: 忙碌的、繁忙的、无暇的；热闹的、（电话）占线的
examples: How will we all keep busy when we only have to work 15 hours a week? 要是每周只上 15 小时班，剩下的时间人该怎么打发？

buy.sense: 购买、买；相信、接受（说法）；收买
examples: Perhaps people just never feel materially satisfied, always wanting more money to buy the next new thing. 头一种解释是：人永远不知足，总惦记着赚钱买下一个新玩意儿。

call.sense: 称呼（call sb sth）；打电话；呼叫
examples: This is what we call the third space. 这就是我们所说的「第三空间」。

more.confusables: call sb sth（称某人某物）/ call sb up（打电话）/ so-called（所谓的）

cannot.sense: 不能（can 的否定形式，写成一个词）
examples: Companies cannot do all these things and then turn around. 公司不能做了这些又反过来改口。

more.confusables: cannot（一个词，正式）/ can not（分写，多用于强调 not）/ can't（口语缩写）

examples: They are doing work they care about and are interested in, and doing more of it is not necessarily a burden. 干的本就是自己上心、感兴趣的事，多干点也算不上负担。

more.confusables: care / career / carefully（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

case.sense: 事例、情况、案例；案件；箱子、盒（in case 万一）

more.confusables: in case（万一，连词，从句用一般现在时表将来）/ in case of + 名词（假如发生，介词短语）/ in the case of（就…而言）/ in no case（绝不，置句首主句倒装）/ in any case（无论如何）

examples: If that were the case, why did the duration of the working week decline in the first place? 真要是这样，工时最早那段下降又怎么解释？
Error rates have been stable for a century. 错误率一个世纪以来都很稳定。

more.roots: cent（百，词根，同 percent/centimeter）+ -ury（名词后缀）
more.confusables: century（世纪）/ decade（十年）

change.sense: 改变、变化 / 变化、零钱
examples: Attitudes are changing slowly. 态度正在缓慢改变。

more.confusables: change（改变）/ exchange（交换）/ alter（改动，更正式）

examples: But then something changed. 可后来，风向变了。

more.confusables: changed / change / change-induced（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

chronologically.sense: 按时间顺序地、按年代先后
examples: Unlike the other two explanations Friedman considers, this one fits chronologically(按年代). 前两条对不上时间线，唯独这一条按年代排得上。
She discussed it with colleagues. 她和同事讨论了这件事。

more.confusables: colleague（同事）/ college（学院）

compensated.sense: 补偿、弥补、赔偿（compensate 的过去式/过去分词）
examples: And, of course, they are compensated for it at a level that makes it worth their while. 当然，报酬也高到让他们觉得值。

complete.sense: 完整的、彻底的、完成的；完成、结束、填写
examples: This can be seen in the median worker's income over this time period, complete with a shift in 1973 that fits in precisely with when the working week stopped shrinking. 看中位数工人的收入曲线就明白了：1973 年有个拐点，恰好卡在工时不缩的那一年。

more.confusables: complete / completed / completely（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

concern.sense: 担忧、关心、关切的事；涉及、关于、使担忧（concerned about）

more.confusables: concern（关切、担忧，名词；涉及、使担忧，动词）/ be concerned about（担心…，介词 about）/ be concerned with（与…有关；关注…，介词 with）/ concerning（关于，介词）/ as far as … is concerned（就…而言）

examples: This is confirmed by a recent poll that found that, for half of hourly workers, their top concern is not that they work too much but that they work too little. 近期一项民调也印证了：半数按小时计酬的工人最怕的不是干太多，而是没得干。

concludes.sense: 断定、得出结论；结束、终止（第三人称单数）
examples: Friedman concludes that the prosperity(繁荣) Keynes predicted is here. 弗里德曼的结论是：凯恩斯预言的那种繁荣，确实来了。

conclusive.sense: 确凿的、决定性的、结论性的（本文指证据尚不充分）

more.roots: con-（加强）+ clus（关闭，词根）+ -ive（形容词后缀）
more.confusables: conclusive（确凿的、决定性的，指证据/结果，如 conclusive evidence）/ inconclusive（无定论的）/ conclusive 与 convincing（convincing 指「说服人」，conclusive 指「一锤定音」）

examples: But Friedman argues that the evidence for this theory is far from conclusive. 可弗里德曼说，这点证据根本不足以定论。

confirmed.sense: 证实、确认、批准（过去式）；根深蒂固的、习惯的

more.confusables: confirm（确认、证实，及物）/ confirm that / confirm sth（不说 confirm of）/ confirmed（确认的；积习难改的，a confirmed bachelor）/ confirmation（名词）/ confirm 与 conform（遵守，conform to，拼写易混）

examples: This is confirmed by a recent poll that found that, for half of hourly workers, their top concern is not that they work too much but that they work too little. 近期一项民调也印证了：半数按小时计酬的工人最怕的不是干太多，而是没得干。

connections.sense: connection 的复数，人脉、联系（本文指人脉）
examples: Another theory Friedman considers is that, in an era of ever fewer settings that provide effective opportunities for personal connections and relationships, people may place more value on the socializing that happens at work. 还有一种解释：如今能让人正经交朋友的场合越来越少，于是上班时的社交反倒更值钱了。

consider.sense: 考虑、细想；认为、把…看作；顾及、体谅

more.confusables: consider doing（考虑做，接动名词，不接 to do）/ consider sb/sth (to be) + adj/n（认为…是）/ consider that（认为）/ take … into consideration（把…考虑在内）/ considerate（体贴的）与 considerable（相当大的）形近义远

examples: Many people today consider colleagues as friends. 不少人确实把同事处成了朋友。

considers.sense: 考虑、细想；认为、把…看作；顾及、体谅（consider 的复数/三单形式）
examples: Another theory Friedman considers is that, in an era of ever fewer settings that provide effective opportunities for personal connections and relationships, people may place more value on the socializing that happens at work. 还有一种解释：如今能让人正经交朋友的场合越来越少，于是上班时的社交反倒更值钱了。

more.confusables: considers（复数/三单）/ consider（原形）

continue.sense: 继续（continue to do / continue doing）
examples: The practice continues in many firms. 这种做法在许多公司延续。

more.roots: con-（一起）+ tin（握、持，词根 ten/tain/tin = hold，同 contain/maintain）+ -ue
more.confusables: continue to do / continue doing（都对，前者强调新阶段）/ continuous（连续的）

continuing.sense: 继续（continue to do / continue doing）（continue 的现在分词/动名词形式）
examples: Instead of continuing to decline, the duration of the working week remained stable. 工时不再往下掉，而是稳住了。

more.confusables: continuing（现在分词/动名词）/ continue（原形）

convincing.sense: 令人信服的、有说服力的；说服、使确信（convince 的现在分词）

more.roots: con-（加强）+ vinc（征服，词根）+ -ing（形容词后缀）
more.confusables: convincing（令人信服的，指论据、说法）/ convinced（确信的，指人，be convinced of/that）/ convincing 与 persuasive（persuasive 侧重「能打动人」）

examples: A third possibility proves more convincing for Friedman. 在弗里德曼看来，还是第三种解释最站得住。

course.sense: 课程；过程、进程；路线（of course 当然）
examples: And, of course, they are compensated for it at a level that makes it worth their while. 当然，报酬也高到让他们觉得值。

more.confusables: course / court（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

darker.sense: 更暗的、更深色的、更昏暗的（dark 的比较级）
examples: But Friedman says that, for Americans, reality is much darker. 可弗里德曼说，放到美国，现实远没这么美好。

data.sense: 数据（datum 的复数，现代英语也常作不可数，谓语单复皆可但须一致）
examples: The data show a clear trend. 数据显示出明确的趋势。

more.confusables: data（数据）/ date（日期）

examples: Three decades after his retirement he is still famous. 退役三十年后他依然出名。

more.confusables: decade（十年）/ decade 前用 three 不加 of

decline.sense: 下降（不及物）；拒绝（及物）/ 下降、衰退
examples: Reading rates have declined. 阅读率下降了。

more.confusables: decline（下降，不及物）/ refuse（拒绝）/ decline to do（婉拒）

declined.sense: 下降、减少、衰退；婉拒、谢绝（decline 过去式/分词）
examples: Inequality declined in America during the period following World War II, along with the duration of the working week. 二战后那几十年，贫富差距和工时是一道往下走的。

more.confusables: declined / decline（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

derive.sense: 源于、来自、得自（derive from）；推导、取得

more.roots: de-（从…）+ riv（河流，词根 riv = stream，同 river/rival）→ 从源头引出 → 源于、得到
more.confusables: derive from（源自，介词 from）/ derive sth from（从…获得/导出）/ be derived from（由…衍生）/ derivation（派生，名词）/ derivative（派生物；导数）/ derive 与 deprive（剥夺，拼写易混）

examples: These top earners derive meaning from their jobs and work is an important part of how they think of themselves. 工作给了他们意义感，也构成了自我认同的重要一块。

distributed.sense: 分发、分配、分布、散布（过去式）；分布式的

more.confusables: distribute（分发、分配；分布，及物）/ distribute sth to/among sb（介词 to 或 among）/ distribution（名词）/ distribute 与 contribute（contribute to 是「贡献/有助于」，不是分发）

examples: In Keynes's vision, the resulting unemployment would be distributed more or less evenly across society in the form of increased leisure. 他设想的是：腾出来的活儿均摊给所有人，变成大家多出来的闲暇。

doing.sense: 做、干、从事（do 的现在分词/动名词）；所作的事、活动

doubled.sense: 翻倍、加倍、对折（double 过去式/分词）；加倍的
examples: According to Friedman, between 1947 and 1973 the average hourly wage for normal workers (those who were not in management roles) in private industries other than agriculture nearly doubled in terms of what their money could buy. 弗里德曼算过：1947 至 1973 年，剔除管理层、不算农业，普通私企员工的时薪按实际购买力几乎翻倍。

dramatically.sense: 显著地、急剧地、大幅地；戏剧性地
examples: But since the early 1970s it has risen dramatically. 可打七十年代初起，贫富差距又猛地拉开了。

duration.sense: 持续时间、期间（for the duration of 在…期间）

early.sense: 早的、早期的、初期的；提早、在早期（early on 早先）
examples: But since the early 1970s it has risen dramatically. 可打七十年代初起，贫富差距又猛地拉开了。

more.confusables: early / earlier（同族不同词形，注意词性与用法）

earners.sense: 挣钱者、有收入的人（复数，本文谈高收入者）
examples: (Indeed, research has shown that the highest earners in America tend to work the most.) （确有研究发现：美国挣得最多的那批人，反而干得最久。）
